# InformationTheoreticSelection

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A selection mechanism that operates on the information content and predictive value of phenotypic traits, rather than solely on survival or reproduction metrics. Guides the design of self-organizing network topologies in TCC where nodes evolve to maximize mutual information with their environment.
